sloka: आज्ञप्तो रावणेन इत्थम् प्रतिकूलम् च राजवत् ।अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् निःशन्को राक्षसाधिपम् ॥३-४१-१॥
transliteration: ājñapto rāvaṇena ittham pratikūlam ca rājavat ।abravīt paruṣam vākyam niḥśanko rākṣasādhipam ॥3-41-1॥

translations.english: At this royal command which was against his interest Maracha used harsh words to the demonking:
